counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 0.013564776551038028 to 0.001 (single field change) to increase time resolution; this makes the same 32-step close encounter integrate accurately and removes the energy_conserved violation.

explanation: Shrunk 2-body scenario undergoes a deep close encounter near the pericenter: distance shrinks to ~0.43 at step 31 and ~0.105 at step 32, well below the softening length 0.3, with large masses (~17 and ~14.8) and high G ~4.79. The fixed outer dt=0.0135, even split into 13-16 substeps, is too coarse to resolve the strongly accelerated motion (speeds ~18.5 and potential ~-3800 at violation). Leapfrog integration error accumulates non-symplectically, producing a large spurious drop in total energy from ~+26 initially to ~-292 at step 32 (~318 change vs allowed ~146), while the dt=0.001 counterfactual integrates accurately and conserves energy.
vision_note: From step 29 to 32 the two blue bodies rapidly close from a small vertical separation to near-coincidence. By step 31 they overlap and by step 32 they appear as a single merged body, showing an extreme close encounter.
